description: This file is the main React component for the Career Navigator application's front-end UI. It manages the user interface for uploading documents, generating and managing AI personas, displaying progress, and handling orchestration responses. The component integrates various hooks, state management, file uploads, orchestrations, and UI interactions to provide an interactive experience for building and finalizing user personas based on uploaded documents.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a string array, filtering out non-string or empty values.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials for a display label, used for avatar icons.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Accesses a nested value in an orchestration response safely, returning the value and its found path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys present within orchestration response objects for debugging shape mismatches.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from orchestration response records, trying multiple candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the frontend PersonaData shape, inferring fields and enriching data.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a string fingerprint of PersonaData to detect changes.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint of the raw persona JSON artifact response to detect changes.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component managing the UI states for persona creation, upload, orchestration, and finalization.
